strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged ECI wage signal is above its threshold; otherwise short SPY. (Procyclical orientation: high/accelerating wage inflation = risk-on.) Rebalanced QUARTERLY (first quarterly pair).
lead_description: Signal lead = 6 QUARTER(S) (~18 months); L1 is the real-time floor (BLS releases quarter Q's ECI ~1 month after quarter end)

selection.objective_formula: oos_ret.mean()/oos_ret.std()*sqrt(4) — QUARTERLY annualization — maximised over the full valid strategy population (SA source: no seasonal-cleanliness restriction; ECON-T4 benchmark excluded); ties resolved by the ECON-T3 cascade
selection.rationale: Maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the full tradable QUARTERLY lead grid L1..L8 (1268 valid combos; median valid OOS Sharpe 0.7179). FIRST QUARTERLY PAIR: leads in quarters (L1=~3M pub-lag floor, L8=2yr), Sharpe annualized by sqrt(4). ECON-LT1 gate: full grid scanned natively -> no staleness possible. SMALL-SAMPLE CAVEAT (STRONG): OOS = 25 QUARTERS only -> the winner is found-in-search / CANDIDATE, never a validated edge; the caveat is stronger than any monthly pair to date.

notes: Mode 1, feat260705_eci_spy — FIRST QUARTERLY PAIR (annualization sqrt(4); leads/lookbacks/oos_n in QUARTERS). Tournament: 2336 strategy combos (+1 benchmark, valid=False per ECON-T4), 1268 valid, sparse grid over full tradable lead grid L1..L8 quarters. Winner by ECON-T3 cascade (resolved at step 5; 2 tied at step 1). SMALL-SAMPLE / FOUND-IN-SEARCH (STRONG): OOS window is 25 QUARTERS -> the winner is a CANDIDATE, not a validated edge; OOS Sharpe is high-variance. Winner stationarity class: regime_contaminated. Lead-lag verdict (empirical): ECI->SPY TY-Granger sig lags(q) NONE, SPY->ECI sig lags(q) [1, 2, 3, 4]; pre-whitened CCF sig lead(+) lags NONE, lag(-) lags NONE -> classified 'lagging'. Winner's own lead-curve peaks at L6q (published L6q). Robustness: winner bootstrap p=0.12 (vs resampled B&H); IS Sharpe -0.23 vs OOS 1.60; CP1 durability 'conditionally_durable'; corr sign-stability 'sign_unstable'. Gross of costs; sensitivity in tournament_validation_20260706/.
